### R

```{r}
#| label: gd-zigzag-3d-r
#| echo: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
#| eval: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
#| fig-alt: >-
#|   Surface plot of f of x equal to one half of x1 squared plus 3 x2 squared
#|   over x1 from -0.5 to 3.5 and x2 from -1 to 1.2, a bowl that is steeper
#|   along the x2 axis than along the x1 axis. A blue path of line segments
#|   with circles lies on the bowl. It starts at the point (3, 1), then goes
#|   to (1.5, -0.5), (0.75, 0.25), and (0.375, -0.125), alternating between
#|   the two sides of the valley floor and descending toward the origin,
#|   which is marked by a vermilion diamond at the bottom of the bowl.
gz_x1_sf <- seq(-0.5, 3.5, length.out = 101)
gz_x2_sf <- seq(-1, 1.2, length.out = 101)
gz_grid_sf <- tidyr::expand_grid(x1 = gz_x1_sf, x2 = gz_x2_sf)
gz_value_sf <- 0.5 * (gz_grid_sf$x1^2 + 3 * gz_grid_sf$x2^2)
gz_n2_sf <- length(gz_x2_sf)
gz_z_sf <- matrix(gz_value_sf, nrow = gz_n2_sf)
gz_steps_sf <- 0:3
gz_path_x1_sf <- 3 * 0.5^gz_steps_sf
gz_path_x2_sf <- c(1, -0.5, 0.25, -0.125)
gz_path_sf <- tibble::tibble(x1 = gz_path_x1_sf, x2 = gz_path_x2_sf)
gz_path_sf$z <- 0.5 * (gz_path_sf$x1^2 + 3 * gz_path_sf$x2^2)
gz_origin_sf <- tibble::tibble(x1 = 0, x2 = 0, z = 0)
gz_line_sf <- list(color = "#0072B2", width = 5)
gz_dot_sf <- list(color = "#0072B2", size = 4)
gz_mark_sf <- list(color = "#D55E00", size = 6, symbol = "diamond")
gz_stops_sf <- c(0, 1)
gz_cols_sf <- c("#E5E5E5", "#808080")
gz_scale_sf <- list(gz_stops_sf, gz_cols_sf)
gz_eye_sf <- list(x = 1.6, y = -1.6, z = 0.9)
gz_camera_sf <- list(eye = gz_eye_sf)
gz_xaxis_sf <- list(title = "x1")
gz_yaxis_sf <- list(title = "x2")
gz_zaxis_sf <- list(title = "f(x)")
gz_scene_sf <- list(
  xaxis = gz_xaxis_sf,
  yaxis = gz_yaxis_sf,
  zaxis = gz_zaxis_sf,
  camera = gz_camera_sf
)
gz_legend_sf <- list(orientation = "h")
plotly::plot_ly() |>
  plotly::add_surface(
    x = gz_x1_sf,
    y = gz_x2_sf,
    z = gz_z_sf,
    colorscale = gz_scale_sf,
    showscale = FALSE,
    opacity = 0.7
  ) |>
  plotly::add_trace(
    data = gz_path_sf,
    x = ~x1,
    y = ~x2,
    z = ~z,
    type = "scatter3d",
    mode = "lines+markers",
    line = gz_line_sf,
    marker = gz_dot_sf,
    name = "iterates"
  ) |>
  plotly::add_markers(
    data = gz_origin_sf,
    x = ~x1,
    y = ~x2,
    z = ~z,
    marker = gz_mark_sf,
    name = "minimizer"
  ) |>
  plotly::layout(scene = gz_scene_sf, legend = gz_legend_sf)
```

#| eval: !expr isFALSE(knitr::is_html_output())

### Python

```{python}
#| label: gd-zigzag-3d-python
#| fig-alt: >-
#|   Surface plot of f of x equal to one half of x1 squared plus 3 x2 squared
#|   over x1 from -0.5 to 3.5 and x2 from -1 to 1.2, a bowl that is steeper
#|   along the x2 axis than along the x1 axis. A blue path of line segments
#|   with circles lies on the bowl. It starts at the point (3, 1), then goes
#|   to (1.5, -0.5), (0.75, 0.25), and (0.375, -0.125), alternating between
#|   the two sides of the valley floor and descending toward the origin,
#|   which is marked by a vermilion diamond at the bottom of the bowl.
#| fig-height: 4.5
#| fig-width: 6
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

gz_x1_3d, gz_x2_3d = np.meshgrid(np.linspace(-0.5, 3.5, 101),
                                 np.linspace(-1, 1.2, 101))
gz_f_3d = 0.5 * (gz_x1_3d**2 + 3 * gz_x2_3d**2)
gz_path_x1_3d = 3 * 0.5 ** np.arange(4)
gz_path_x2_3d = np.array([1, -0.5, 0.25, -0.125])
gz_path_f_3d = 0.5 * (gz_path_x1_3d**2 + 3 * gz_path_x2_3d**2)
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(6, 4.5))
ax = fig.add_subplot(projection="3d")
ax.plot_surface(gz_x1_3d, gz_x2_3d, gz_f_3d, color="grey", alpha=0.4)
ax.plot(gz_path_x1_3d, gz_path_x2_3d, gz_path_f_3d, "o-", color="#0072B2",
        label="iterates")
ax.scatter([0], [0], [0], marker="D", color="#D55E00", s=50, label="minimizer")
ax.set_xlabel("x1")
ax.set_ylabel("x2")
ax.set_zlabel("f(x)")
ax.legend(loc="upper right")
plt.show();
```

:::

The [graph](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-graph) of $f(\vx) = \tfrac{1}{2} (x_1^2 + 3 x_2^2)$,
the surface whose [level curves](vector-calculus.qmd#def-level-curve) are in @fig-gd-zigzag,
with the same four [iterates](#def-iterate) of [gradient descent](#def-gradient-descent) lifted onto it.
The surface is steeper along the $x_2$ axis than along the $x_1$ axis,
so each step overshoots the bottom of the valley and
the path zigzags down toward the [minimizer](algebra.qmd#def-global-minimizer) $\vzero$ (diamond).

:::
